content.text:
I've submitted the portfolio. It is an equal-weight blend of 235 slower trend signals: tsmom with lookbacks of 63, 126 and 252 days, plus the ma (21,63) and (50,200) crossovers, across all 47 industries. It scored a validation Sharpe of about 0.16 and a training Sharpe of about −0.16, so it is weak and I wouldn't expect it to be reliable.

I chose this blend after seeing family-level validation results, so the 0.16 is optimistic. Portfolios built from the best training signals did worse in validation (about −0.3 to −0.4), which suggests the training edge doesn't carry over. The faster signals (5 and 21 days) and the always-long hold signals lost money in validation, so I left them out.
